description: Check an explicitly supplied street and city in France against the IGN Géoplateforme address directory. The street and city are sent to IGN for lookup. A current exact directory match does not verify an image, a business, historical existence, or spelling read from a frame; no match is inconclusive. Inspect the image separately and do not infer a fictional street from no match. Free and subject to availability.
name: check_french_street_directory
title: Check a French street name against the national address directory
